site.name: Diriyah, At-Turaif
site.notes: heavy_rain_days_per_year is ASSUMED until Basma computes it (hadaq_sim.cli rain-frequency). demo_storm_date = the real past storm we replay (hadaq_sim.cli storms).

building.name: Focus building (to be chosen)
building.notes: Pick the building, click it in the web app, copy its OSM elementId here and into apps/web/.env (VITE_FOCUS_OSM_ID).

walls.name: Main facade
walls.notes: azimuth_deg = direction the facade faces (outward), degrees from north. base_line is a PLACEHOLDER: Omar replaces it with the real wall base (Shift+click in the web app prints coordinates). start = LEFT end of the wall base when you stand in front of the facade (that is column C1).

zones.cols_counted_from: left, standing in front of the facade

cameras.notes: wall_bbox_px = [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the wall face inside the photo. Abdurhmn sets it from the real photo series.
